note: Starter draft — confirm with a planning engineer before relying on it.

activities.name: Fabrication Yard / Workshop Setup
activities.why: Local fabrication needs a laydown/workshop with power, cranes and welding stations before any steel or spool work can start.

activities.name: Material Receipt, Inspection & MTO Reconciliation
activities.why: Fabrication cannot outrun certified material; incoming inspection and MTO reconciliation are frequently omitted and cause rework.

activities.name: Structural Steel Fabrication (Cut / Fit-up / Weld / NDT)
activities.why: The core local-fabrication activity; welding and NDT drive quality sign-off before coating and erection.

activities.name: Pipe Spool Fabrication
activities.why: Spools are locally fabricated and NDT'd before field installation; a common long-lead within the fab scope.

activities.name: Blasting, Painting & Galvanizing
activities.why: Surface protection follows fabrication and NDT and must precede erection to avoid coating damage and work at height.

activities.name: Equipment Foundations & Grouting
activities.why: Foundations, anchor bolts and grout must reach strength before equipment can be set and aligned.

activities.name: Equipment Erection, Setting & Alignment
activities.why: Static/rotating equipment is rigged, set on foundations and precision-aligned/grouted; alignment governs downstream piping and hook-up.

activities.name: Piping Installation, Bolt-up & Hydrotest
activities.why: Field spools connect to installed equipment; hydrotest and flushing precede mechanical completion.

activities.name: E&I Cabling, Termination & Loop Check
activities.why: Power and instrument hook-up follows equipment setting; loop checks precede commissioning.

activities.name: Mechanical Completion & Pre-Commissioning
activities.why: MC walkdown, punch-listing and pre-commissioning confirm the installation is ready before commissioning and handover.

logic_rules.reason: Fabrication can only start on certified, inspected material — starting welding before material receipt is unrealistic.
Coating follows completed fabrication and NDT sign-off.
Coated/protected steel and equipment are erected after surface protection to avoid damage and rework at height.
Equipment is set only after foundations, anchor bolts and grout reach strength.
Piping and E&I hook-up connect to equipment only after it is set and aligned.
Commissioning follows hydrotest, loop checks and mechanical completion.

common_issues: Fabrication started before material receipt / inspection is modelled
No blasting/painting (coating) activity between fabrication and erection
Equipment erection before foundation grout reaches strength
Piping / E&I hook-up not tied to equipment alignment
Missing mechanical completion / pre-commissioning before commissioning
No local fabrication yard / workshop setup activity
